decision: Provider credentials stay in the shared proxy. Each runner mints a short-lived app/company/job/session-bound token. Missing, revoked, foreign or expired trust fails closed; the agent never falls back to a provider credential. OpenRouter is supported at the proxy through bearer auth and a reviewed model prefix. Consumer ChatGPT/Codex plan login is deliberately not copied into an autonomous backend because it would move an interactive account credential into the runtime.
